items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Lonnie Johnson. ... Sure. In those days, because nowadays he got electric, you see, when he learned to play the guitar, he just playing straight out muscle guitar, making sound like electric guitar dude now.
